title: Email verification code field has no accessible name
steps: Start the local stack; register a new test account in Chromium; capture the accessibility tree on 'Check your email' (Playwright ariaSnapshot).
expected: The code input is announced as e.g. 'Verification code, 6 digits'.
actual: The code input has no <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby; the accessibility tree shows an unnamed textbox. It already has autocomplete='one-time-code' and inputmode='numeric'.
impact: Screen-reader users hear 'edit text' with no purpose on the step that gates every new account.
fix: Add aria-label='Verification code' (or a visible <Label htmlFor>), keeping the existing autocomplete and inputmode. Full a11y sweep follows in Wave 4.
